flow.label: Farmer
flow.text: Milk is poured at the village centre. The machine records quantity, fat and SNF.

flow.label: Centre
flow.text: Society or chilling centre keeps the farmer-wise record.

flow.label: Gate
flow.text: Tanker arrives at the plant gate and is entered in the gate register.

flow.label: Reception
flow.text: Weighbridge and lab test the milk. Good milk is accepted, bad milk is rejected.

flow.label: Silo
flow.text: Accepted milk is unloaded into a silo and stock increases.

flow.label: Production
flow.text: Milk becomes curd, paneer, ghee and butter in batches.

flow.label: Dispatch
flow.text: Milk is loaded into a tanker and sent to a plant, booth or customer.

flow.label: Money
flow.text: Farmer payments, sales and accounting vouchers close the loop.

modules.title: Dashboard
modules.summary: One screen that shows how the plant is doing right now.
steps: Open the app after login. You land here.
Read the six number cards: collected today, received at plant, silo stock, vehicles inside, farmer dues, sales today.
Check the 14 day chart to see if milk is rising or falling.
Check silo levels, collection by centre and gate activity to spot anything unusual.
Tap any quick link to jump straight to a module.
modules.tip: Start every shift here.

modules.title: Account: sign in, sign up, sign out
modules.summary: Create a plant account, sign in and sign out.
steps: Open Create account, fill name, email, plant name, role and a strong password.
Sign in with your email and password; tick Keep me signed in to stay logged in.
Use Forgot password on the login page to request a reset link.
Press the red sign-out button at the bottom of the sidebar to log out.
modules.tip: Demo login: admin@kshira.in / kshira123.

modules.title: Gate entry
modules.summary: Digital register of every vehicle and visitor that enters or leaves the plant.
steps: Press New gate entry when a vehicle arrives.
Fill vehicle number, driver, type (milk tanker, feed, staff, visitor), party and purpose.
The entry shows as Inside with the entry time.
When the vehicle leaves, press Mark exit on that row.
Use the filter to see only vehicles still inside.
modules.tip: A milk tanker entered here is what the Reception team picks up next.

modules.title: Milk reception
modules.summary: Weigh and test every incoming tanker, then accept or reject it and send it to a silo.
steps: Press Receive tanker.
Enter tanker number, route, quantity in litres, fat, SNF, temperature and acidity.
Choose the silo to unload into.
Pick Accepted, Rejected or Pending.
Accepted litres are added to that silo stock automatically.
modules.tip: Temperature above 8 C or acidity above 0.16 should normally be rejected.

modules.title: Silos and stock
modules.summary: Live view of every milk tank with fill level and temperature.
steps: Each tank shows how full it is and its temperature.
Red or amber tanks need attention (almost full or too warm).
Use the numbers to decide which silo receives the next tanker.
modules.tip: Keep raw milk below 5 C.

modules.title: Dispatch
modules.summary: Milk going out of the plant in tankers.
steps: Press New dispatch.
Enter tanker, destination, quantity, fat and SNF.
Status starts as Loading, then On route, then Delivered.
Update the status from the table as the trip progresses.
modules.tip: Pair this with a Milk tanker out entry in Gate entry.

modules.title: Machine collection
modules.summary: Farmer-wise records coming from the milk analyser and weighing machine at the village centre.
steps: Every row is one farmer, one shift: litres, fat, SNF, rate and amount.
Filter by shift or search by farmer name or code.
Press Simulate machine entry to see how a new reading appears live.
Export the table to CSV for the centre.
modules.tip: Rate is calculated from fat and SNF, so the farmer sees exactly why the amount changed.

modules.title: Farmers
modules.summary: Master list of milk suppliers.
steps: Press Add farmer to register a new supplier.
Enter name, village, centre, milk type and phone.
Advance given to the farmer is shown here and is deducted at payment time.
modules.tip: Keep phone numbers right so bills can be sent by SMS later.

modules.title: Quality lab
modules.summary: Spot low fat, low SNF and rejected tankers before they become a loss.
steps: Cards show average fat, SNF and rejection rate.
The chart shows daily average fat and SNF.
The alert list shows farmer readings below the limit and rejected tankers.
modules.tip: Repeated low SNF from one farmer often means water mixing.

modules.title: Rate chart
modules.summary: Price per litre for every fat and SNF combination.
steps: Read the colour grid: darker cells pay more.
Use the calculator: type fat, SNF and litres to see the rate and amount.
Show the grid to farmers so they understand their payment.
modules.tip: Rate = fat x 6.20 + SNF x 3.10 in this demo. Change the formula in lib/data.ts.

modules.title: Farmer services
modules.summary: Vet visits, vaccination, artificial insemination and health checks.
steps: Press Book a visit and pick farmer, service, animal tag and vet.
Visits start as Scheduled.
Press Mark done after the vet visit.
Charges add up in the top cards.
modules.tip: Healthy animals mean steady milk and better fat.

modules.title: Inventory
modules.summary: Stock of cattle feed, products, packing, chemicals and fuel.
steps: Items below their reorder level show a red Low badge.
Press Add item to create a new stock item.
Search or filter by category.
modules.tip: Cleaning chemicals running out can stop the whole plant.

modules.title: Production
modules.summary: Batches of milk, curd, paneer, ghee and butter.
steps: Press New batch, choose the product and litres of milk to use.
Press Start when work begins.
Press Complete when the batch is done; output and yield % are filled in.
Filter by product to compare yield.
modules.tip: Low yield for the same product is an early sign of a process problem.

modules.title: Purchases
modules.summary: Purchase orders to vendors for feed, packing, chemicals and fuel.
steps: Press New purchase order and choose vendor, item, quantity and rate.
Order starts as Ordered.
Mark received when goods arrive, then mark paid after payment.
modules.tip: Order before an item hits its reorder level in Inventory.

modules.title: Sales
modules.summary: Product and milk sales to shops, hotels and booths.
steps: Press New sale.
Enter customer, product, quantity and rate. Amount is calculated.
Mark paid or unpaid.
Outstanding amount is shown at the top.
modules.tip: Chase unpaid sales every Monday.

modules.title: Customers
modules.summary: Customer master with credit limit and outstanding.
steps: Press Add customer and enter type, city, phone and credit limit.
Customers over their credit limit show a red badge.
Check this list before accepting a new credit order.
modules.tip: Stop supply to customers who are over limit and unpaid.

modules.title: Accounting
modules.summary: Vouchers for money received, money paid and adjustments.
steps: Press New voucher.
Choose Receipt, Payment or Journal, the account and the amount.
Totals of debit, credit and the balance update immediately.
Filter by voucher type or search by account.
modules.tip: Use the same account names every time so reports stay clean.

modules.title: Farmer payments
modules.summary: 10-day payment cycle for farmers, calculated from the machine collection.
steps: Each farmer row shows litres, gross amount, advance deduction and net payable.
Press Pay on a row after the bank transfer or cash payment.
Paid rows turn green and the pending total drops.
modules.tip: Advance is deducted in parts so the farmer never gets zero.

modules.title: Expenses
modules.summary: Daily plant expenses with manager approval.
steps: Press New expense and fill head, description, amount and payment mode.
The entry waits as Pending.
The manager presses Approve.
modules.tip: Keep bills for every cash expense.

modules.title: Fleet
modules.summary: Tankers, vans, drivers and routes.
steps: See each vehicle with its driver and route.
Status shows Running, Idle or Maintenance.
Press Add vehicle to register a new one.
modules.tip: Keep one spare tanker idle for emergencies.

modules.title: HR and payroll
modules.summary: Employees, attendance and monthly salary total.
steps: Tap Present or Absent on a row to mark today attendance.
Top cards show headcount, present today and monthly payroll.
Press Add employee to register staff.
modules.tip: Mark attendance before 10 am.

modules.title: Assets and service
modules.summary: Plant machines with next service date and condition.
steps: See every machine with its location and next service date.
Overdue dates turn red.
After repair, press Mark fixed.
modules.tip: Service the chiller and boiler before the summer peak.

modules.title: Reports
modules.summary: Ten ready reports, each with live numbers, a chart, a full table, CSV download and print.
steps: Choose a report tab: daily collection, farmer-wise, reception, gate, dispatch, production, accounts, sales, stock or payroll.
Read the four number cards and the chart.
Scroll to the data table; sort, page through and check rows.
Press Download CSV for Excel or Print for paper.
modules.tip: Download month-end reports on the last day.

modules.title: Settings
modules.summary: Theme, plant name and alert limits.
steps: Switch between light and dark theme.
Change the plant name shown in the sidebar.
Set minimum fat and SNF limits for alerts.
modules.tip: Change limits only with the plant manager approval.

modules.title: Users and roles
modules.summary: Who can sign in and what role they have.
steps: Press Invite user and enter name, email and role.
Press Disable to block a user who left the company.
Filter by role.
modules.tip: Give each person only the access they need.

modules.title: Help and contact
modules.summary: Raise a support request and read quick answers.
steps: Choose a topic, write the subject and message.
You get a ticket number like KS-1234.
Your recent requests are listed on the page.
modules.tip: Mention the machine model for analyser or weighbridge help.
